Package dev.turboism.sdk.storage

Interface PluginStorage

public interface PluginStorage
Asynchronous, plugin-confined storage service.

Every StoragePath is resolved below the calling plugin's runtime-assigned StorageRoot; this API never accepts an arbitrary filesystem path. The runtime checks permissions, rejects path and symbolic-link escapes, serializes mutations as needed, and reports operational failures as structured results. It does not expose revisions, compare-and- set, or a general filesystem capability; plugins needing conflict resolution must store and validate their own application-level version data.

Operations run on runtime-owned I/O workers. Completion settlement and dependent stage callbacks without an explicitly selected executor are dispatched through the plugin's bounded task executor, not the I/O worker. Closing the plugin scope cancels outstanding I/O where possible and makes subsequent calls report runtime unavailability.

    • readUtf8

      CompletionStage<StorageReadResult<String>> readUtf8(StoragePath path, int maxBytes)
      Reads at most maxBytes from one regular file and decodes the bytes as strict UTF-8.
      Parameters:
      path - confined path of the file to read
      maxBytes - maximum returned byte count, from 0 through the runtime operation limit
      Returns:
      a stage containing text or a structured error; a successful value may be truncated
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if path is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxBytes is negative

      CompletionStage<StorageListResult> list(StoragePath directory, int maxEntries)
      Lists direct entries in a confined directory, bounded by maxEntries.
      Parameters:
      directory - confined directory to inspect
      maxEntries - maximum entries returned, from 0 through the runtime list limit
      Returns:

      Throws:

    • copy

      CompletionStage<StorageMutationResult> copy(StoragePath source, StoragePath target, boolean replaceExisting)
      Copies one regular file between confined roots, optionally replacing the target.

      The operation needs both read and write permission. Its target update uses the runtime's atomic replacement path where available; it is not a revision-based compare-and-set.

      Parameters:
      source - confined source file
      target - confined target file
      replaceExisting - whether an existing regular target may be replaced
      Returns:
      a stage containing whether the copy changed storage or a structured error
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if source or target is null

    • moveAtomic

      CompletionStage<StorageMutationResult> moveAtomic(StoragePath source, StoragePath target, boolean replaceExisting)
      Atomically moves a confined entry within one storage root when the backend supports it.
      Parameters:
      source - confined source entry
      target - confined target entry in the same root
      replaceExisting - whether an existing regular target may be replaced
      Returns:
      a stage containing whether the move changed storage or a structured error; cross-root requests report StorageErrorCode.CROSS_ROOT_ATOMIC_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if source or target is null

    • delete

      CompletionStage<StorageMutationResult> delete(StoragePath path, boolean recursive)
      Deletes a confined file or directory.
      Parameters:
      path - confined entry to delete
      recursive - whether a directory may be deleted recursively; recursive deletion is bounded and can report StorageErrorCode.PARTIAL_DELETE
      Returns:
      a stage containing whether anything changed or a structured error
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if path is null
